title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-04-09
source: Source:  Unknown Taper+Equipment>MA>Cass(Unk); Conversion: NAK Dragon>Cass>WAV>FLAC; FLAC encoding via TLH

ai_review.summary: Electric set sounds clear while the acoustic portion suffers from tape warble; despite an imperfect tape the powerful 1970 Fillmore West performance shines through.
ai_review.review: Reviewers note that the electric portion of this April 9 1970 show is pleasant, but the acoustic set is marred by noticeable tape warble and overall tape imperfections. The band’s energy and power are praised strongly, outweighing the recording flaws for most listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers praise the band's performance but criticize tape quality; high show value balanced against moderate recording issues yields an overall rating around 4 stars, though only two reviews limit confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape warble on the acoustic set and general tape imperfections noted; electric portion sounds clearer.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Electric portion received positive remarks, while the acoustic segment was hindered by tape issues; overall performance described as powerful.
